items.headline: Wall Street recovers most early losses as pullback in AI stocks eases
items.summary: U.S. stocks closed moderately lower after a sharp early decline eased. Nvidia fell 3.9%, while investors continued to question whether AI valuations and infrastructure spending can generate sufficient profits.

items.headline: Strong U.S. economy continues into Q4
items.summary: October PCE inflation rose 3.8% year over year and core PCE rose 3.3%, while strong growth increased expectations of further Federal Reserve tightening. Axios also reported that market turbulence raises risks of an AI-investment slowdown.

items.headline: Stocks' Downward Spiral Continues on AI Correction
items.summary: Schwab reported renewed selling in Nvidia and other AI-linked names, with elevated volatility, higher rate-hike expectations, and proposed tariffs adding to market pressure.
